notes: Methodologically the strongest content analysis in the shard (complete two-year scrape of a general-purpose board, topic-neutral keyword, codebook with Cohen kappa 0.91, fact-checker library as reference standard); only weakness is that 27.5% is per vaccine-thread, not per unit of audience exposure.

quote_item6: Misinformation level in the videos was categorized according to the following definitions: information with over 50 % misinformation was labeled as "inaccurate or misinformative"; videos with under 50 % but above 25 % misinformation were considered as "partially accurate"; videos with under 25 % misinformation were defined as "accurate and evidence-based."

notes: The extracted quantity is a VIQI information-accuracy median, and the misinformation thresholds (>50%, 25-50%) are applied per video with no defined unit and no inter-rater statistic, over the top 150 hashtag videos from a single day.

notes: 47.5% "low quality" is a GQS educational-quality band, not falsity, computed over 61 surviving videos from a single-day four-keyword search on one rare dermatological condition.
